title: Submitting with unanswered fields, no brake type, or a value without verdict
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  • A template with a required Per axle field.
  • Fill it to produce: no verdict anywhere; an axle with Drum/Disc left blank; and a position with a value but no verdict.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a per-axle field with no verdict anywhere counts as unanswered and blocks submit when the field is required.
2. Confirm that when Drum or Disc is left blank, nothing about brake type appears in the report.
3. Confirm a position with a value and no verdict is not counted as a finding and does not block submit.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A per-axle field with no verdict anywhere counts as unanswered and blocks submit when the field is required.
  • If Drum or Disc is left blank, nothing about brake type appears in the report.
  • A position with a value and no verdict is not counted as a finding and does not block submit.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9106 (S8 — Record measurements per axle); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S8; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1: “A per-axle field with no verdict anywhere counts as unanswered and blocks submit when the field is required”
  • S8-N2: “If Drum or Disc is left blank, nothing about brake type appears in the report”
  • S8-N3: “A position with a value and no verdict is not counted as a finding, and does not block submit”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
